evidence:
Static mapping of every launch assumption in frozen tests/test.sh to the public brief (instruction.md + /instructions notes):
(1) Entry: test.sh:68 refuses grading without /app/server.js; test.sh:97,111 runs `node /app/server.js` (or the copy). Told: instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'starts from /app/server.js'.
(2) Port: test.sh:48,108 PORT=3000, probes 127.0.0.1:3000. Told: instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0' (so a 127.0.0.1 probe and the judge's localhost both reach it).
(3) Liveness: test.sh:48 probes /api/health then / and accepts any HTTP response (HTTPError -> ready). Told: instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10.
(4) DB_PATH: test.sh:98-101,109 sets DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db. Told: instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:201 'Honor the supplied DB_PATH'.
(5) Env vars: test.sh:104-109 `env -i` with PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH only. Told exactly: hireops_rules.md:201-202 'The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH; do not rely on inherited shell variables.'
(6) Unprivileged uid 65534, other cwd, writable-copy fallback: test.sh:87,90-102,110. Told: hireops_rules.md:198-201 (runs as an unprivileged user, may launch a writable copy, cwd may differ, resolve bundled UI/seed relative to entry/module dir).
(7) Deps: test.sh relies on NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally, matching environment/Dockerfile:9-12. Told: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4,18-19 (use NODE_PATH, only Express/better-sqlite3/built-ins).
(8) Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 rejects symlinks outside /app/node_modules. Told verbatim: integration.md:16-19.
(9) Seed / no shipped DB: test.sh does not reseed or delete app.db; the app must self-seed. Told: instruction.md:15 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime. Load ... once, start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts'; hireops_rules.md:204-209. Frozen environment/assets/seed_data.json is byte-identical in content to solution/app/src/seed_data.json (sorted JSON compare), and holds the Platform Engineer order (Applied: Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen: Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz) that functional hro_restart (judge.toml:402-407) cites.
(10) Restart helper: test.sh:127-193 SIGTERMs the process group and relaunches over the same DB with the same env. Told: instruction.md:15 'keep new work across restarts'; integration.md:8-9 'Restarting ... keeps all data, and seeding never duplicates records'.
(11) Judge URL: all five prompt.md line 1 and app_context.md:4 use http://localhost:3000, consistent with port 3000/0.0.0.0. No same-origin requirement (correct for public network). No fixed clock is assumed by test.sh (no TZ/clock env injected) and none is promised by the brief.
Known false positive respected: sign-in (instruction.md:17 lists accounts anyway).
Adversarial: (a) broken app that might pass: one that reads /assets/seed_data.json at runtime; task.toml artifacts include /assets and test.sh:88 chmods it, so it may still work at grade time despite instruction.md:15 saying /assets is unavailable -> lenient, not an untold launch assumption (Note-level only). An app shipping a stale app.db is not cleaned by test.sh, but the brief forbids it and hro_restart checks the seeded order/note. (b) Conforming app that might fail: an app needing more than ~30 s to answer HTTP (test.sh:116-125, 120 x 0.25 s) gets zero; the brief gives no explicit deadline but integration.md:9-10 requires health to answer before DB work can block startup, and the seed is small (16 applications, 127 messages), so no realistic conforming app is affected (P3 latent). An app binding only 'localhost'/::1 would fail the 127.0.0.1 probe but violates integration.md:6 (0.0.0.0), so is not conforming.
Runtime corroboration (not a test.sh execution): raw-evidence-index.json entries re-hashed: all 6 artifact sha256 match and all 12 matching_source_files hashes match the frozen solution bytes. workspace.cjs:16 launches node /app/server.js with the same sanitized env (PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000, DB_PATH) as uid 65534 and restarts via SIGTERM (workspace.cjs:459); workspace.json reports the golden passed its groups including restart. That is a scripted golden run, not a full test.sh/RewardKit launch; full-verifier launch evidence belongs to rows 19/21/22 and the pipeline runtime records, and its absence is noted but does not leave any test.sh assumption untold to the agent.
